explication: PowerMate Agent turns physical knob and button input into scroll, audio, keystroke, and configured press actions, with menu-bar configuration and automatic per-app overrides. The graph includes the HID driver, settings/UI, audio and LED capabilities, and status presentation. Some helper implementations were indexed or read but their call sites were not shown; those links are omitted rather than inferred.
